title: Snowshoe Through Vancouver's Winter Wonderland
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Hotel pickup and drop-off (downtown Vancouver hotels only)
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately for winter conditions.
Dress Winter clothing, warm coat or jacket, hat and gloves, dress in layers, hiking boots/leather boots or sneakers
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Escape the rainy city weather and step into a winter wonderland just 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver. Our guided snowshoe tours offer an exciting way to discover a snowy winter paradise in the North Shore of Vancouver. Join us and venture through the snow-covered forests and majestic mountains.
